newsitem.title: USA: GTE files suit against Wash. utilities commission.
newsitem.headline: GTE files suit against Wash. utilities commission.

text.p: GTE Corp on Friday said it filed a suit in the Western District Court of Washington state challenging the arbitration order involving the company and AT&T handed down on December 11 .
In a statement, the company said the arbitration order violated its rights under the U.S. Telecommunications Act of 1996.

The company said the order sets the prices and terms under which GTE would make its local telephone services and network available to AT&T. AT&T would then use those services and network to compete for GTE's existing local customers.
Among other things, the commission's orders would require GTE to provide its services to AT&T at wholesale discounts of 18.8 percent, the company said.

Instead of pricing network elements based on cost, as the 1996 Act requires, the commission's order would also require GTE to provide its network elements to AT&T at an effective discount of approximately 70 percent, GTE added.

On Thursday, GTE filed suit in federal district court in Illinois and Virginia and claiming that those AT&T arbitration orders violated its rights under the Telecommunications Act. On December 12, GTE filed a similar suit in Pennsylvania.
